paite: Solomon paunakte. Tapa pil in pa kipak abawl a; himahleh tapa hai anu gikna ahi.
heading: Solomon Paunakte
english: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son makes a glad father; but a foolish son brings grief to his mother.

paite: Gitlouhna sumte'n bangmah aloh tak kei; himahleh diktatna in sihna a kipan atankhia hi.
english: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing, but righteousness delivers from death.

paite: TOUPA'N midiktat kialsih aphal kei ding; himahleh migilou a kipan atankhia hi.
english: Yahweh will not allow the soul of the righteous to go hungry, but he thrusts away the desire of the wicked.

paite: Khut ze-ol mi ahong genthei a; himahleh mithanuam khut in hauhsakna abawl hi.
english: He becomes poor who works with a lazy hand, but the hand of the diligent brings wealth.

paite: Nipi lai a lakhawmpa tapa pil ahi; himahleh pawltak hun a ihmu zumhuai omsak tapa ahi.
english: He who gathers in summer is a wise son, but he who sleeps during the harvest is a son who causes shame.

paite: Midiktat lutung ah vualzawlnate a-om a; himahleh gilou kam hiamgamna in atuam hi.
english: Blessings are on the head of the righteous, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.

paite: Midik theihgigena anuam a; himahleh migilou min amuat mang ding.
english: The memory of the righteous is blessed, but the name of the wicked will rot.

paite: Lungtang pil in thupiakte asang ding a; himahleh mihai haiham apuk ding.
english: The wise in heart accept commandments, but a chattering fool will fall.

paite: Tangtak a pai hoihtak in apai a; himahleh alampite kilawmlousak theih in a-om ding hi.
english: He who walks blamelessly walks surely, but he who perverts his ways will be found out.

paite: Amit a chiamtehna bawl in lungkhamna a-omsak a; himahleh mihai haiham apuk ding.
english: One who winks with the eye causes sorrow, but a chattering fool will fall.

paite: Midiktat kam hinna tuikhuk ahi; himahleh hiamgamna in gilou kam atuam hi.
english: The mouth of the righteous is a spring of life, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.

paite: Huatna in kidouna atokthou a, himahleh itna in tatlekna tengteng akhuh hi.
english: Hatred stirs up strife, but love covers all wrongs.

paite: Theihkak theihna neimi muk ah pilna muh in a-om; himahleh chiang theihsiamna neiloumi nungzang a ding ahi.
english: Wisdom is found on the lips of him who has discernment, but a rod is for the back of him who is void of understanding.

paite: Mipilte'n theihna akholkhawm ua; himahleh mihai kam in siatna anaih.
english: Wise men lay up knowledge, but the mouth of the foolish is near ruin.

paite: Mihausa hauhsakna akhopi muanhuai ahi; migenthei siatna agentheih uh ahi.
english: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city. The destruction of the poor is their poverty.

paite: Midiktat sepgimna in hinna azuan a; gilou punna in khelhna lam.
english: The labor of the righteous leads to life. The increase of the wicked leads to sin.

paite: Bawlhoihna limsak hinna lampi ah a-om a; himahleh salhna don lou apaikhial hi.
english: He is in the way of life who heeds correction, but he who forsakes reproof leads others astray.

paite: Huatna sel zuauthei mukte a kipan ahi a; huan migensiatna gen mihai ahi.
english: He who hides hatred has lying lips. He who utters a slander is a fool.

paite: Thu tampite ah tatlekna a-om lou kei a; himahleh amukte thuzoh in piltak in ahih hi.
english: In the multitude of words there is no lack of disobedience, but he who restrains his lips does wisely.

paite: Midiktat lei dangka hoihpen bang ahi; migilou lungtang athamatna neuchik ahi.
english: The tongue of the righteous is like choice silver. The heart of the wicked is of little worth.

paite: Midiktat mukte'n mi tampi avak a; himahleh mihaite theihsiamna taksap ziak in asi uh.
english: The lips of the righteous feed many, but the foolish die for lack of understanding.

paite: TOUPA vualzawlna in hauhsakna abawl a, huan huai ah lungkhamna abehlap kei hi.
english: Yahweh’s blessing brings wealth, and he adds no trouble to it.

paite: Mihai a ding in gitlouhna hih kisukhalhna bang ahi; huchibang in theisiammi a ding in pilna ahi.
english: It is a fool’s pleasure to do wickedness, but wisdom is a man of understanding’s pleasure.

paite: Migilou launa, amah tung ah ahong tung ding; midiktat deihna phal in a-om ding hi.
english: What the wicked fear will overtake them, but the desire of the righteous will be granted.

paite: Pingpei alenmang bang in, migilou a-om nawn kei; himahleh midiktat tangtawn suangphum ahi.
english: When the whirlwind passes, the wicked is no more; but the righteous stand firm forever.

paite: Zu thuk in ha asuksiat bang in meikhu in mit asusia a, huchibang mah in amah sawlte a ding in mi zongzaw a-om hi.
english: As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, so is the sluggard to those who send him.

paite: TOUPA kihtak in nite asausak a, himahleh migilou kumte hihtom ahi ding.
english: The fear of Yahweh prolongs days, but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.

paite: Midiktat lametna kipahna ahi ding, himahleh migilou lametna amangthang ding.
english: The prospect of the righteous is joy, but the hope of the wicked will perish.

paite: TOUPA lampi a mitangte a ding in kulh muanhuai ahi; himahleh migilou nasem mite a ding in siatna ahi.
english: The way of Yahweh is a stronghold to the upright, but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.

paite: Midiktat suankhiak ahi ngei kei ding; himahleh gamsung ah migilou ateng kei ding hi.
english: The righteous will never be removed, but the wicked will not dwell in the land.

paite: Midiktat kam in pilna ahon tun a; himahleh lei gina lou satkhiak in a-om ding.
english: The mouth of the righteous produces wisdom, but the perverse tongue will be cut off.

paite: Midiktat mukte'n lak tuak bang ahia athei a, himahleh migilou kam in ginatlouhna agen hi.
english: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable, but the mouth of the wicked is perverse.
